runSummary.note: Real 16 Sep 14:40 sweep. Twelve independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Pretlak, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities, public Facebook indexing and broad public company-career discovery. LinkedIn surfaced Wolt full-time remote Support Associate in Bratislava at 1,200-1,270 EUR/month, but minimum B2 English plus morning/evening/weekend shifts materially reduce fit, so it was not promoted. Brigada.sk surfaced a Bratislava Mlynske Nivy reception brigade at 6 EUR net/hour plus meal allowance, but student orientation and communicative English requirement make it a weak fit. Upwork surfaced current WooCommerce work, but the strongest operational listing remains three weeks old with 20-50 proposals and an existing hire. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Shift-window fit score
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Normalize customer-support and operations roles by actual service window, weekend frequency and required shift flexibility so apparently remote roles do not outrank better daytime jobs when their schedule burden is materially worse.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Student-contract eligibility gate
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Detect when a brigade is student-only versus merely student-friendly, and suppress or penalize offers whose legal contract form is unavailable to the candidate before spending time on application preparation.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data was attempted.
